description: This file defines the interface EmailCampaignWritePlatformService, which provides methods for creating, updating, deleting, activating, closing, and reactivating email campaigns, as well as generating reports and previewing messages within the email campaign module of the Fineract project.

classes.name: EmailCampaignWritePlatformService
classes.description: Service interface for managing email campaigns, including CRUD operations, status management, report generation, and message previewing.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new email campaign based on the provided JSON command.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing email campaign identified by resourceId with data from the JSON command.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes the email campaign identified by resourceId.

methods.name: activateEmailCampaign
methods.description: Activates the email campaign specified by campaignId using details from the JSON command.

methods.name: closeEmailCampaign
methods.description: Closes the email campaign specified by campaignId.

methods.name: reactivateEmailCampaign
methods.description: Reactivates a previously closed or inactive email campaign identified by campaignId.

methods.name: getRunReportByServiceImpl
methods.description: Generates a report based on reportName and queryParams; may throw an IOException.

methods.name: previewMessage
methods.description: Returns a preview of an email message based on the provided query.

methods.name: insertDirectCampaignIntoEmailOutboundTable
methods.description: Inserts a campaign directly into the email outbound table with associated loan, campaign, and parameters.
